title: Dataset Based on Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) Cultivations including Turbidity, Permittivity, O2 and CO2 Measurements
question: How do cultivation settings and feed history affect cell growth and metabolite trajectories?
publisher: Uhlendorff, Selina (Institute for Life Science Technologies (ILT.NRW), OWL University of Applied Sciences and Arts, Lemgo, Germany); Fulek, Ruwen (Institute Industrial IT (inIT), OWL University of Applied Sciences and Arts, Lemgo, Germany); Eimler, Jonas (Institute for Life Science Technologies (ILT.NRW), OWL University of Applied Sciences and Arts, Lemgo, Germany); Pein-Hackelbusch, Miriam (Institute for Life Science Technologies (ILT.NRW), OWL University of Applied Sciences and Arts, Lemgo, Germany); Frahm, Björn (Biotechnology and Bioprocess Engineering, OWL University of Applied Sciences and Arts, Lemgo, Germany)
measurement_dates: Campaign dates unknown; each cultivation lasts 161.5–328.5 hours.
variables_and_units: inline sensors, offline metabolites, cell growth and feeds
independent_units: 12 paired cultivation experiments, retain reactor pairs together
validation_design: 12 paired cultivation experiments, retain reactor pairs together Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Twelve original 16-sheet workbooks plus 48 author time-axis-aligned CSVs. Inline alignment corrects clock drift; aligned and original streams are not independent observations.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Keep each parallel-reactor experiment pair together. Nine batch and three fed-batch experiments; use offline references with inline signals and keep modes explicit.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.

eligibility.novelty: no unseen-law guarantee; independent adjudication required

exposure: Open source-aware; source literature and supplied analyses accessible
unit_interpretation: Use exact source field/sheet/channel labels and units in source_evidence and per-file reports; unknown units remain unresolved, not inferred from a variable name.
